cache: Warm JVM and OS cache; Spark cached tables cleared each repetition. Not cold.
compression: zstd in both legacy Parquet and all Iceberg tables
variant_order: legacy, unpartitioned, partitioned, before, after; order bias possible

legacy.query:
SELECT count(*) events, sum(units) units FROM benchmark_legacy
        WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-07 00:00:00'
          AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2025-01-08 00:00:00'

unpartitioned.query:
SELECT count(*) events, sum(units) units FROM lake.fair_performance.bench_b93f24c96e_unpartitioned
        WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-07 00:00:00'
          AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2025-01-08 00:00:00'

partitioned.query:
SELECT count(*) events, sum(units) units FROM lake.fair_performance.bench_b93f24c96e_partitioned
        WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-07 00:00:00'
          AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2025-01-08 00:00:00'

before_compaction.query: SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units,sum(length(payload)) payload_bytes FROM lake.fair_performance.bench_b93f24c96e_small_files

after_compaction.query: SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units,sum(length(payload)) payload_bytes FROM lake.fair_performance.bench_b93f24c96e_small_files
